Class Msghdr

java.lang.Object
org.lwjgl.system.Pointer.Default
org.lwjgl.system.Struct<Msghdr>
org.lwjgl.system.linux.Msghdr
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, NativeResource, Pointer
@NativeType("struct msghdr") public class Msghdr extends Struct<Msghdr> implements NativeResource
struct msghdr {
    void * msg_name;
    socklen_t msg_namelen;
    struct iovec * msg_iov;
    size_t msg_iovlen;
    void * msg_control;
    size_t msg_controllen;
    int msg_flags;
}

  • Constructor Details

    • Msghdr

      public Msghdr(ByteBuffer container)
      Creates a Msghdr instance at the current position of the specified ByteBuffer container. Changes to the buffer's content will be visible to the struct instance and vice versa.

      The created instance holds a strong reference to the container object.
